rewind.confirmMessageConversationOnly: Rewind conversation to this point? File changes will be kept.
rewind.noticeSaveFailed: Rewound: {count} file(s) reverted, but failed to save state: {error}
rewind.noticeConversationOnlySaveFailed: Rewound conversation, but failed to save state: {error}

fork.unavailableNoResponse: Cannot fork: no response to fork from
fork.commandNoMessages: Cannot fork: no messages in conversation
fork.commandNoAssistantUuid: Cannot fork: no assistant response with identifiers

view.moveBlockedStreaming: Wait for the current response to finish before moving the Qoderian view.
view.moveFailed: Could not create the Qoderian view in the selected location.

queue.title: Waiting to send {count}
queue.paused: Queue paused because you interrupted the current response
queue.steerUnavailable: Can't steer right now. The message stays in the queue.

drop.context: Drop notes, folders, or images here to add as context
drop.ignored: Ignored {count} unsupported file(s); only notes, folders, and images can be dropped

default.label: Ask approval
default.desc: Always ask before running commands, editing files outside the vault, or accessing the network

auto.label: Auto approval
auto.desc: Only ask when a potential risk is detected

yolo.label: Full access
yolo.desc: Never asks; freely accesses your files, terminal, and network

plan.label: Plan
plan.desc: Explore and draft a plan without making changes

slashCommand.requiresInteractiveTerminal: This command needs an interactive Qoder terminal and cannot run inside Obsidian.

userName.name: What should Qoderian call you?
userName.desc: Your name for personalized greetings (leave empty for generic greetings)

excludedTags.name: Excluded tags
excludedTags.desc: Notes with these tags will not auto-load as context (one per line, without #)

mediaFolder.name: Media folder
mediaFolder.desc: Folder containing attachments/images. When notes use ![[image.jpg]], Qoder will look here. Leave empty for vault root.

systemPrompt.name: Custom system prompt
systemPrompt.desc: Additional instructions appended to the default system prompt

autoTitle.name: Auto-generate conversation titles
autoTitle.desc: Automatically generate conversation titles after the first user message is sent.

titleModel.name: Title generation model
titleModel.desc: Model used for auto-generating conversation titles.

navMappings.name: Vim-style navigation mappings
navMappings.desc: One mapping per line. Format: "map <key> <action>" (actions: scrollUp, scrollDown, focusInput).

requireCommandOrControlEnterToSend.name: Require Command/Ctrl+Enter to send
requireCommandOrControlEnterToSend.desc: When enabled, Enter inserts a newline. Command+Enter sends on macOS; Ctrl+Enter sends on Windows and Linux.

slashCommands.name: Commands and Skills
slashCommands.commandsDesc: Reusable prompts stored as .qoder/commands/*.md and invoked with /name.
slashCommands.skillsDesc: Agent capabilities stored as .qoder/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. A skill folder may also contain scripts, references, and templates.
slashCommands.noCommands: No project commands configured. Click + to create one.
slashCommands.noSkills: No project skills configured. Click + to create one.
slashCommands.unavailable: Qoder CLI command catalog is unavailable.
slashCommands.duplicateName: A command or skill named "{name}" already exists

modal.name: Name
modal.nameDesc: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only
modal.descriptionDesc: Briefly explain when Qoder should use it
modal.commandInstructionsDesc: Prompt sent when the command is invoked. Use $ARGUMENTS for user input.
modal.skillInstructionsDesc: Instructions Qoder follows when this skill is activated.
modal.skillInstructionsPlaceholder: Explain the workflow, constraints, and expected output for this skill.

mcpServers.name: MCP Servers
mcpServers.desc: Manage vault-level MCP server configurations stored in .qoder/mcp.json. Servers with context-saving mode require @mention to activate.

plugins.name: Qoder Plugins
plugins.desc: Manage Qoder plugins discovered from ~/.qoder/plugins. Enabled plugins are stored per vault in .qoder/settings.json.

subagents.name: Subagents
subagents.desc: Manage vault-level subagents stored in .qoder/agents/. Each Markdown file defines one custom agent.
subagents.noAgents: No subagents configured. Click + to create one.
subagents.renameCleanupFailed: Warning: could not remove old file for "{name}"

modal.name: Name
modal.nameDesc: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only
modal.descriptionPlaceholder: Reviews code for bugs and style
modal.toolsDesc: Comma-separated list of allowed tools (empty = all)
modal.disallowedToolsDesc: Comma-separated list of tools to disallow
modal.promptPlaceholder: You are a code reviewer. Analyze the given code for...

loadUserSettings.name: Load user Qoder settings
loadUserSettings.desc: Load ~/.qoder/settings.json. When enabled, user's Qoder CLI permission rules may bypass Safe mode.

qoderSafeMode.name: Safe mode permissions
qoderSafeMode.desc: Permission behavior used while the Safe toggle is on.

enableBangBash.name: Enable bash mode (!)
enableBangBash.desc: Type ! on empty input to enter bash mode. Runs commands directly via Node.js child_process. Requires view reopen.

validation.noNode: Node.js not found on PATH. Install Node.js or check your PATH configuration.

maxTabs.name: Maximum chat tabs
maxTabs.desc: Maximum number of concurrent chat tabs (3-10). Each tab uses a separate Qoder session.
maxTabs.warning: More than 5 tabs may impact performance and memory usage.

enableAutoScroll.name: Auto-scroll during streaming
enableAutoScroll.desc: Automatically scroll to the bottom as Qoder streams responses. Disable to stay at the top and read from the beginning.

deferMathRenderingDuringStreaming.name: Defer math rendering during streaming
deferMathRenderingDuringStreaming.desc: Show raw LaTeX while responses stream, then render math once when each text block completes.

expandFileEditsByDefault.name: Expand file edits by default
expandFileEditsByDefault.desc: Show Write and Edit diffs expanded when they first appear.

chatViewPlacement.name: Open Qoderian in
chatViewPlacement.desc: Choose where the chat panel opens when it is created

cliEdition.name: Qoder CLI edition
cliEdition.desc: Choose the international build (qodercli, ~/.qoder) or the China build (qoderclicn, ~/.qoder-cn). Open tabs restart immediately after switching, interrupting in-progress conversations. Session history is stored separately per edition (~/.qoder and ~/.qoder-cn) and is not shared between editions.

cliPath.name: Qoder CLI path
cliPath.desc: Custom path to Qoder CLI. Leave empty for auto-detection.
cliPath.descWindows: For the native installer, use qodercli.exe. For npm/pnpm/yarn installs, use the @qoder-ai/qodercli cli.js path (not qodercli.cmd).
cliPath.descUnix: Paste the output of "which qoder" — works for both native and npm/pnpm/yarn installs.

validation.isDirectory: Path is a directory, not a file

language.name: Language
language.desc: Change the display language of the plugin interface
